Details 
 This trucker hat celebrates a commitment to quality that dates back to 1865 and features a western landscape design on its brushed cotton front and barbed-wire-inspired detail across its brim. It has a traditional mesh back for breathability, a gently curved bill and a classic snapback closure to ensure a secure, adjustable fit.
 Truck drivers throughout the 20th century wore caps branded with their company’s logo. By the ‘70s, they had evolved into the hat we know and appreciate today. Practical, proud, and pure Americana, the trucker hat is a true classic.
- 3 ⅞” Crown
- 2 ¾” Brim
- Adjustable Snapback Closure
- Polyester Mesh Back
- 100% Cotton
